# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows

List repository workflows from default branch

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-280`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — ActionWorkflowResponse

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `total_count` | int64 | total number of workflows |
| `workflows` | []ActionWorkflow | list of workflows |

- **400** — invalid request
- **403** — insufficient permissions
- **404** — repository not found
- **500** — internal error reading git tree
